{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').mean()

# Print the number of unique patients after deduplication
len_df_dedup = len(df_dedup)

# Print the fraction
fraction_severe, len_df_dedup"}
